fixedSetup.formation: Canonical per encounter; formationId is taken from the saved native trial rows.
fixedSetup.sufficientMpRule: Both-role sufficiency must be true on every included matched trial; paid-MP means are separate observed outcomes.

rankInterpretation: Within-encounter order follows each tuple's own cohort mean and is descriptive; it is not proof of a reliable winner or equivalence.
selectionRule: Only exact tuples with a separate audited cohort of n=200, unknown=0, and sufficient MP for both roles. For repeated exact tuples keep the largest n, then the latest cohort timestamp. No pooling and no outcome-based duplicate choice.
